value.text: Research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions: reinvent productivity and business processes; build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform; create more personal computing.

strategic_priorities.quote:
To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:
•
Reinvent productivity and business processes.
•
Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform.
•
Create more personal computing.

value.text: Growth depends on securely delivering continuous innovation and advancing leading productivity and collaboration tools and services, including Microsoft 365, LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our growth depends on securely delivering continuous innovation and advancing our leading productivity and collaboration tools and services, including Microsoft 365, LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365.

value.text: Continue to invest in high performance and sustainable computing to meet growing demand for fast access to Microsoft services provided by its network of cloud computing and AI infrastructure and datacenters.

strategic_priorities.quote: We continue to invest in high performance and sustainable computing to meet the growing demand for fast access to Microsoft services provided by our network of cloud computing and AI infrastructure and datacenters.

value.text: Increased investments in the development and deployment of specialized supercomputing systems to accelerate OpenAI's research, under a long-term partnership with OpenAI.

strategic_priorities.quote: We have a long-term partnership with OpenAI, a leading AI research and deployment company. We deploy OpenAI’s models across our consumer and enterprise products. As OpenAI’s exclusive cloud provider, Azure powers all of OpenAI's workloads. We have also increased our investments in the development and deployment of specialized supercomputing systems to accelerate OpenAI’s research.

value.text: Focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across solution areas.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas.

value.text: Investing significant resources in transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact.

strategic_priorities.quote: Transforming the workplace to deliver new modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another.

value.text: Investing in building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

strategic_priorities.quote: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

value.text: Investing in applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains.

strategic_priorities.quote: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using natural methods of communication.

value.text: Investing in tackling security from all angles with integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

strategic_priorities.quote: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

value.text: Investing in inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any devices and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

strategic_priorities.quote: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any devices and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

value.text: Using Windows to fuel the cloud business, grow share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass.

strategic_priorities.quote: Using Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more.

value.text: Future growth depends on the ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

value.text: Committed to being a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

strategic_priorities.quote: In 2020, we committed to being a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

value.text: Continuing to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand datacenter locations and increase server capacity to meet evolving customer needs, particularly given the growing demand for AI services.

strategic_priorities.quote: We continue to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand our datacenter locations and increase our server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services.

value.text: Maintaining a long-term commitment to research and development across a wide spectrum of technologies, tools, and platforms spanning digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

strategic_priorities.quote: Based on our assessment of key technology trends, we maintain our long-term commitment to research and development across a wide spectrum of technologies, tools, and platforms spanning digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

value.text: Established a regulatory governance framework with an initial focus on four domains: Responsible AI, Privacy, Digital Safety, and Cybersecurity.

strategic_priorities.quote: To comply with the accelerating global regulatory obligations, we established a regulatory governance framework and to create a repeatable system-focused approach to regulatory governance with an initial focus on four domains: Responsible AI, Privacy, Digital Safety, and Cybersecurity.

value.text: Focused on growing the gaming platform and expanding to new ecosystems to engage as many gamers as possible.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are focused on growing the platform and expanding to new ecosystems to engage as many gamers as possible.

value.text: Continuing to make progress toward the overall commitment to double the number of Black and African American and Hispanic and Latinx leaders in the U.S. by 2025.

strategic_priorities.quote: We also continue to make progress toward our overall commitment to double the number of Black and African American and Hispanic and Latinx leaders in the U.S. by 2025.

value.text: Prioritizing fundamentals, with security above all else — launched the Secure Future Initiative (SFI)

strategic_priorities.quote:
Going forward, we are focused on three priorities: First, prioritizing fundamentals, with security above all else. We
launched the Secure Future Initiative (SFI) this year, bringing together every part of our organization to advance
cybersecurity protection.

value.text: Driving trustworthy AI innovation across our entire portfolio while continuing to scale our cloud business

strategic_priorities.quote:
Second,
driving trustworthy AI innovation across our entire portfolio while continuing to scale our cloud business.

value.text: Managing our cost structure dynamically to generate durable, long-term operating leverage

strategic_priorities.quote:
And, finally,
managing our cost structure dynamically to generate durable,
long-term
operating leverage.

value.text: Reinventing the company as tech paradigms shift, to stay relevant to customers, partners and employees

strategic_priorities.quote:
we have seized the opportunity to reinvent ourselves to stay relevant to
our customers, our partners, and our employees. And that’s what we are doing again today.

value.text: Building three leading platforms for the agentic era: Copilot, the Copilot stack, and Copilot devices

strategic_priorities.quote:
Microsoft has built three leading platforms to help our customers maximize their opportunity in this emerging
agentic era: Copilot, which you can think of as the new UI for AI—the human interface for this agentic world; the
Copilot stack, which brings together infrastructure, data, and app services to help customers build their own copilots
and agents for their own business processes; and a new category of Copilot devices that are purpose-built for this
new era, including the Copilot+ PCs we introduced this year.

value.text: Expanding cloud and AI capacity with new investments across five continents as long-term assets

strategic_priorities.quote:
This year, we expanded our cloud and AI capacity, announcing new investments across five continents. These are
long-term assets to drive new growth for the next decade and beyond

value.text: Four enduring commitments: expanding opportunity, earning trust, protecting fundamental rights, advancing sustainability

strategic_priorities.quote:
And that’s why we are focused on four
enduring commitments. They keep us grounded, serving as a guide as we make decisions

value.text: Expanding total addressable market by integrating Copilot into third-party systems

strategic_priorities.quote: And we are expanding our total addressable market by integrating Copilot into third-party systems as well.

value.text: Growth mindset culture in continuous pursuit of high performance

strategic_priorities.quote:
Our growth mindset culture helps us in our continuous pursuit of high performance. It doesn’t matter what we said
about our culture 10 years ago or even last year if we aren’t practicing it today

segments.quote: We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that can power modern business and developers.
Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.

headcount.quote: As of June 30, 2024, we employed approximately 228,000 people on a full-time basis, 126,000 in the U.S. and 102,000 internationally.

value.description: Completed acquisition of Activision Blizzard Inc. for a total purchase price of $75.4 billion, consisting primarily of cash; reported as part of More Personal Computing segment.

events.quote: On October 13, 2023, we completed our acquisition of Activision Blizzard for a total purchase price of $75.4 billion, consisting primarily of cash. The financial results of Activision Blizzard have been included in our consolidated financial statements since the date of the acquisition. Activision Blizzard is reported as part of our More Personal Computing segment.

value.description: Prior-year (fiscal 2023 second quarter) $1.2 billion charge including employee severance, hardware portfolio impairment charges, and lease consolidation costs, excluded from non-GAAP measures.

events.quote: Prior year non-GAAP financial measures exclude the impact of a $1.2 billion charge in the second quarter of fiscal year 2023 (“Q2 charge”), which included employee severance expenses, impairment charges resulting from changes to our hardware portfolio, and costs related to lease consolidation activities.

value.description: Received IRS Notices of Proposed Adjustment for tax years 2004 to 2013 seeking an additional tax payment of $28.9 billion plus penalties and interest, primarily relating to intercompany transfer pricing; company disagrees and will contest.

events.quote: With respect to the audit for tax years 2004 to 2013, on September 26, 2023, we received Notices of Proposed Adjustment (“NOPAs”) from the IRS. The primary issues in the NOPAs relate to intercompany transfer pricing. In the NOPAs, the IRS is seeking an additional tax payment of $28.9 billion plus penalties and interest.

value.description: Share repurchases of 32 million shares for $12.0 billion in fiscal year 2024, with $10.3 billion remaining of the $60 billion program.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2024 and 2023, we repurchased 32 million shares and 69 million shares of our common stock for $12.0 billion and $18.4 billion, respectively, through our share repurchase program. All repurchases were made using cash resources. As of June 30, 2024, $10.3 billion remained of our $60 billion share repurchase program.

value.description: Board of Directors declared dividends totaling $22.3 billion in fiscal year 2024, up from $20.2 billion.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2024 and 2023, our Board of Directors declared dividends totaling $22.3 billion and $20.2 billion, respectively.

value.description: Change in accounting estimate increasing useful lives of server and network equipment from four to six years, effective beginning fiscal year 2023.

events.quote: In July 2022, we completed an assessment of the useful lives of our server and network equipment. Due to investments in software that increased efficiencies in how we operate our server and network equipment, as well as advances in technology, we determined we should increase the estimated useful lives of both server and network equipment from four years to six years. This change in accounting estimate was effective beginning fiscal year 2023.

value.description: Metric presentation changes in Q1 FY2024: Microsoft Cloud revenue metric revised to include revenue growth; Microsoft 365 Consumer subscribers metric expanded to include Microsoft 365 Basic subscribers.

events.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2024, we made updates to the presentation and method of calculation for certain metrics, revising our Microsoft Cloud revenue metric to include revenue growth and expanding our Microsoft 365 Consumer subscribers metric to include Microsoft 365 Basic subscribers, aligning with how we manage our business.

value.description: Microsoft completed its previously announced acquisition of Activision Blizzard, Inc.; Merger Sub merged with and into Activision Blizzard, with Activision Blizzard surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Microsoft.

events.quote: On October 13, 2023, Microsoft Corporation, a Washington corporation (“Microsoft”), completed its previously announced acquisition of Activision Blizzard, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Activision Blizzard”).

value.description: Each outstanding share of Activision Blizzard common stock was cancelled and converted into the right to receive $95.00 in cash, without interest, subject to stated exceptions.

events.quote: was cancelled and automatically converted into the right to receive $95.00 in cash (the “Per Share Amount”), without interest.

value.description: Unvested Activision Blizzard options and stock-based awards were assumed by Microsoft and converted into corresponding Microsoft awards; vested awards were cashed out at the Per Share Amount.

events.quote: In addition, at the Effective Time, subject to certain exceptions, unvested Activision Blizzard options and stock-based awards were assumed by Microsoft and converted into corresponding awards that are subject to shares of Microsoft common stock.

value.description: Microsoft held its 2023 Annual Shareholders Meeting, at which twelve director nominees were elected, say-on-pay was approved on an advisory basis, an annual say-on-pay frequency was approved, Deloitte & Touche LLP was ratified as auditor for fiscal year 2024, and nine shareholder proposals were not approved.

events.quote: On December 7, 2022, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) held its 2023 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,429,030,596 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,340,975,646 were voted in person or by proxy.

value.description: Shareholders ratified the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2024.

events.quote: (4) Voted to ratify the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2024.

value.why_notable: Self-characterization now leads with AI availability and responsibility; "platforms and tools, powered by AI" frames the whole company around AI.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence (“AI”) available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We create platforms and tools, powered by AI, that deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.

value.why_notable: Unusually direct admission that the AI capex build will raise costs and could compress margins.

notable_language.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.

value.why_notable: New emphasis on physical constraints — land, energy, GPUs — as dependencies of the cloud business, a shift from software-oriented risk language.

notable_language.quote: Our datacenters depend on the availability of permitted and buildable land, predictable energy, networking supplies, and servers, including graphics processing units (“GPUs”) and other components.

value.why_notable: Forward-looking commitment to sustained capex escalation over multiple years, not just the coming period.

notable_language.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.

value.why_notable: A reported margin decline is reframed as an increase via the accounting-estimate adjustment; "inclusive of scaling our AI infrastructure" hedges the cost of the AI buildout.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage decreased slightly to 71%. Excluding the impact of the change in accounting estimate, Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage increased slightly driven by improvements in Azure and Office 365 Commercial, inclusive of scaling our AI infrastructure, offset in part by sales mix shift to Azure.

value.why_notable: Unusually combative language on a $28.9 billion tax claim, paired with an explicit statement that resolution is not near.

notable_language.quote: We disagree with the proposed adjustments and will vigorously contest the NOPAs through the IRS’s administrative appeals office and, if necessary, judicial proceedings. We do not expect a final resolution of these issues in the next 12 months.

value.why_notable: Management explicitly quantifies how much of the headline growth is acquisition-driven rather than organic.

notable_language.confidence_reason: quote not found verbatim in the source section, so this item is a paraphrase rather than a traceable citation
notable_language.quote: Xbox content and services revenue increased 50% driven by 44 points of net impact from the Activision Blizzard acquisition. The net impact reflects the change of Activision Blizzard content from third-party to first-party.
notable_language.quote_check: 10-K_item7_mdna: diverges after 124 of 222 characters (56%) — the opening is real but the rest is paraphrased or stitched from elsewhere

value.why_notable: Recurring hedge on demand tied to macro and geopolitical conditions, described as "dynamic" rather than quantified.

notable_language.quote: Aggregate demand for our software, services, and devices is also correlated to global macroeconomic and geopolitical factors, which remain dynamic. We must continue to evolve and adapt over an extended time in pace with this changing environment.

value.why_notable: Explicit negative discretion on the CEO's bonus, framed as CEO-proposed and tied to cybersecurity, while simultaneously insisting formulaic performance was strong.

notable_language.quote: Mr. Nadella proposed, and the Board agreed, that given the focus and speed required for the changes that today’s cybersecurity threat landscape showed were necessary, it was appropriate to reduce Mr. Nadella’s cash incentive award. The Board approved a fiscal year 2024 cash incentive of $5.2 million, which represents more than a 50% reduction from the $10.66 million he would have been awarded based on the combined assessment of strong financial and operational performance.

value.why_notable: The committee's stated rationale for dropping Windows device and Teams usage metrics: an explicit 'significant business shift to AI'.

notable_language.quote: For fiscal year 2024, we updated our PSA core metrics to further align with our key long term strategic priorities. The approved fiscal 2024 PSA metrics reflect a significant business shift to AI through key product focus areas represented by Azure and Other Cloud Services Revenue Growth, Microsoft Cloud Revenue Growth, excluding Azure and Other Cloud Services, and Search and News Advertising Revenue, excluding Traffic Acquisition Costs (“TAC”) Growth while removing Windows 10/11 Monthly Active Device (“MAD”) Growth and Teams Monthly Active Usage Growth

value.why_notable: 'Security our top priority' is new framing that carries into pay design; the SFI expansion is dated, implying escalation during the year.

notable_language.quote: In response to the evolving and challenging cybersecurity threat landscape, Microsoft launched the Secure Future Initiative (“SFI”) in November 2023 and expanded the scope of SFI in May 2024, making security our top priority and committing us to continuous improvement by ensuring that security underpins every layer of our tech stack.

value.why_notable: Directly ties a non-financial priority to pay company-wide — the justification for adding the FY25 Security category.

value.why_notable: A double-counting rationale for removing an engagement metric rather than a strategic one — worth tracking against prior-year emphasis on LinkedIn sessions.

value.why_notable: Standing defense of goal rigor; paired with the separate assertion that FY24 results 'further demonstrat[e] our commitment to rigorous goal setting' despite payouts well above target.

notable_language.quote: In evaluating our compensation practices in fiscal year 2024, our Compensation Committee was mindful of the support our shareholders expressed for our philosophy and practice of linking executive compensation to operational objectives and shareholder value creation and did not make any substantial changes to our executive compensation program.

segments_basis.basis: reportable segments as named by the filing

investor_qa_basis.basis: management's written answers to questions submitted by investors, published roughly monthly. Same verification as every other fact — whole-document boundaries and a checked quote — but a different kind of evidence from a 10-K or proxy statement: unaudited, unprompted by any disclosure requirement, and responsive to whatever was asked. Corroborating; not a substitute for a filed disclosure.

ids.basis: content hash of the claim, its evidence and its source — see `fact_id` in src/equity_research/ledger_schema.py. Confidence and the verification result are NOT hashed, so re-verifying a fact does not renumber it. Cross-year uniqueness is enforced fatally at build time by `audit_ids`.

document_window.basis: filing dates of the documents this year's facts are actually drawn from — NOT the fiscal window in inventory.json, which bounds the fiscal years in scope. Documents reporting on a fiscal year are filed after it ends, so this range extends past window_end_date by construction. Any accession listed above additionally belongs to a fiscal year outside the window and is used deliberately: an annual-meeting vote held in May of year N decides on year N-1.

corrections.basis: config/corrections.toml — human corrections to model-extracted values that the cited filing contradicts, each carrying the filing text that establishes it. data/ledger/facts/ is never edited: the record of what the model returned has to stay as it was.
